text:
liz.park: Heads-up team — NovaBio just signed a 2yr renewal and approved our Azure + AWS marketplace listings for the Private connector. Renewal ARR ~ $360k. They migrated their genomics inference workloads into our Private VPC and asked for a joint case study. Huge thanks to @tara_ops and @kevin_w for the migration and HSM work. :tada:

kevin_w: Migration TL;DR: consolidated 4 model endpoints into one autoscaled pool, enabled envelope KMS + HSM, and applied int8 quantization for their heavy CRISPR model. Early perf: ~38% lower token cost, ~20% P95 latency reduction. Adding graphs to the case draft.

tara_ops: Canary rollout schedule: 5/25/70 over 48h, no user-facing incidents. Small issue during stage 2 where PVC mounts timed out ~1.2% of pods; fixed by increasing mountProbe to 50s and retryCount to 5. Runbook updated: https://notion.redwood/NovaBio-migration-runbook

omid_sales: Customer asked for a short blurb for joint press: "Redwood helped us scale sensitive inference with predictable cost and enterprise-grade security." They want to mention HSM and SSO. Legal: any marketplace contract caveats?

legal-bot: Reviewed. One small data-processing addendum required for cross-region logs retention (customer requested). Legal will upload the signed appendix by EOD Tue.

marketplace-bot: AWS and Azure listings staged. Please confirm support contact and billing SKU mapping. https://console.aws/marketplace/novabio-redwood (staging)

novabio-bot: NovaBio approved logo and provided quote: "Redwood's Private connector gave us the throughput and compliance we needed to put models into production." — NovaBio Head of ML

press-bot: Draft PR created (PR-4991) with placeholder metrics. Marketing: please tighten the customer-facing numbers to single-line bullets. Ops: please add one-sentence migration lessons.

liz.park: I'll spin up the case-study doc in Notion and tag marketing + sales. Link: https://notion.redwood/NovaBio-case-draft. Marketing: target joint announcement next Thursday if legal signs off.

kevin_w: Action items for eng-ml: put the quant config and HSM checklist into Redwood Optimize recipes; add an example of encrypted KV cache setup.

tara_ops: I'll prepare a short postmortem-lite (2 slides) for internal share focusing on the PVC timeout root cause and the fix.

omid_sales: Sales: capture renewal template + negotiation play for marketplace + private connector bundle.

liz.park: Celebration: small team coffee tomorrow 10:30. Also forwarding a summary to execs with a short ROI table. :coffee:

kevin_w: Adding perf graphs to the shared drive and a short "how we got 38% cost reduction" note for eng-ml.

press-bot: Scheduling staggered publish: staging -> production on 2025-03-05T15:00:00Z (task PR-4991).

liz.park: Thanks all. Please drop any final customer-facing lines in the Notion draft today so marketing can finalize the PR.
